Entries.Text: Character Reloader
Use this tool to reload characters in the running game, so changes to their files (behaviors, animations, Havok scripts, etc.) are applied without restarting.
The character reloader is not supported for this project type.
Add all characters to reload list.
Clear all characters from reload list.
Characters to Reload
If a character is included below, then it will be reloaded.
Actions
Reload Characters
Reload all of the characters included above.
Options
Enable File Watcher
If enabled, an included character is automatically reloaded when one of its files in the project is saved externally.
